description: How the parties in a transfer pricing compliance cycle relate to each other on the platform: who mandates and funds the documentation, who asks local finance for data and hands back localised files, how legal entity records and intercompany agreements feed the documentation, how Reptune's specialists and advisory firms deliver for client groups, and how country regulation content flows to everyone who must file.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Plans, service levels, adviser engagements and renewals between the parties

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Task assignments, data requests, document hand-offs and delivery work

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Documentation fees, fixed rates per Local File, adviser spend and audit adjustments

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Status reports, regulatory updates, entity records, reviews and advice

relations.name: Mandates the annual documentation cycle
relations.description: Sets the global transfer pricing policy, the entities and countries in scope, the plan and service level, and the deadlines the manager must meet for the fiscal year.

relations.name: Assigns local tasks and requests entity data
relations.description: Scopes the local file per entity, assigns data collection and review tasks with auto-calculated deadlines, and sends the Excel templates and e-mail reminders the controller works from.

relations.name: Submits validated financials and reviews the draft
relations.description: Uploads entity financials, segmented P&L and transactional data through Excel or ERP integration, resolves validation findings, and reviews the generated local file from the local perspective.

relations.name: Hands over the localised file and filing instructions
relations.description: Delivers the translated, locally compliant local file with the local forms and the country's filing procedure and deadline so the controller can file with the local tax authority.

relations.name: Provides entity records, signatories and agreements
relations.description: Keeps legal entities, shareholders, directors and signatories time-stamped in the Legal Module and files the signed intercompany agreements and structure charts the documentation cites.

relations.name: Requests agreements for uncovered transactions
relations.description: Flags intercompany transactions in the register that lack a signed agreement or whose terms no longer match the model, and asks legal to draft, sign via DocuSign and file them before generation.

relations.name: Reports compliance status and risks
relations.description: Keeps the dashboard and worldmap current per entity and country — scoped, in progress, generated, filed — and raises overdue deadlines, entities outside their arm's-length range and open risks.

relations.name: Engages Full Service or Collaborative delivery
relations.description: Chooses the service level and the number of local files at a fixed rate per Local File, and draws on the plan's expert hours for on-demand advice.

relations.name: Prepares documentation and keeps the client informed
relations.description: Processes data, drafts, localises and translates the Master File and Local Files in the client's workspace while the manager follows progress in the same workflow and dashboard.

relations.name: Advises on value chain, CbCR and controversy
relations.description: Delivers value chain analysis, CbCR analysis, TP model reviews, policy write-ups and support in audits, APAs and MAPs within the expert hours or as consultation.

relations.name: Publishes country rule sets and deadlines
relations.description: Maintains thresholds, content, format, language and deadline rules for 170+ countries so scoping, deadline calculation, templates and R-AI answers reflect the current regulations.

relations.name: Supplies local requirements for countries the firm does not cover
relations.description: Gives the adviser localised templates, local forms and procedures and R-AI country-expert answers for jurisdictions where the firm has no office.

relations.name: Reports local regulatory changes and audit experience
relations.description: Feeds back new local thresholds, forms, language demands and what tax auditors asked for, which the content team turns into template and validation updates.

relations.name: Prepares the client group's documentation on the platform
relations.description: Sets up the client's transfer pricing model in its own division, generates and localises Master File and Local Files and hands them over for filing, with consistent quality across client groups.

relations.name: Pays documentation and controversy fees
relations.description: Funds the adviser's documentation work and audit, APA and MAP support out of the transfer pricing compliance budget, and benchmarks that spend against the platform's cost per entity.

relations.name: Escalates local audits and adjustments
relations.description: Reports local tax audits, information requests and proposed transfer pricing adjustments, with the filed documentation as evidence, so the head of tax can defend the group's position.
